---
title: "Topic 7: Digitalisation"
---

*Use at baseline and endline. Draws from the Flash Eurobarometer on SME Digitalisation and the CIS digital module.*

---

**8.1 Which of the following digital technologies does your company currently use?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Cloud computing services (e.g. data storage, software as a service)
- Big data analytics
- Artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning
- Internet of Things (IoT) / connected devices or sensors
- Robotics or automated production systems
- 3D printing / additive manufacturing
- Blockchain or distributed ledger technology
- Augmented or virtual reality (AR/VR)
- None of the above

*Source: Flash Eurobarometer / CIS digital module. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**8.2 What share of your company's total sales were made online (via website, app, or digital platform) in the last financial year?**
- None
- Less than 10%
- 10–24%
- 25–49%
- 50% or more

*Source: Flash Eurobarometer. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**8.3 Does your company have its own website?**
- Yes, with basic information only
- Yes, including e-commerce functionality
- No

*Source: Flash Eurobarometer. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**8.4 Does your company use social media or digital platforms for business purposes?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Marketing and customer communication
- Sales (e.g. marketplace platforms)
- Recruitment
- Supplier or partner engagement
- We do not use social media or digital platforms for business

*Source: Flash Eurobarometer. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**8.5 How would you rate the overall level of digitalisation of your company's internal processes?**
- Not digitalised (paper-based processes)
- Slightly digitalised (some processes are digital)
- Moderately digitalised (many processes are digital)
- Highly digitalised (most processes are digital)
- Fully digitalised

*Source: Flash Eurobarometer. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**8.6 Did your company invest in digital technologies or software in the last financial year?**
- Yes
- No

*If yes: What was the approximate total investment? (Open numeric field, in €)*

*Source: Flash Eurobarometer / WBES. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**8.7 What are the main barriers preventing your company from further digitalising?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Lack of financial resources
- Lack of staff with digital skills
- Lack of awareness of available technologies or support
- Concerns about cybersecurity or data privacy
- Uncertain return on investment
- Insufficient digital infrastructure (e.g. broadband connectivity)
- Difficulty integrating digital tools with existing systems
- No barriers — we are digitalised to the level we need

*Source: Flash Eurobarometer. Use at: Baseline.*

---

**8.8 Did your company provide digital skills training to employees in the last financial year?**
- Yes, to most or all employees
- Yes, to some employees
- No

*Source: Flash Eurobarometer / WBES. Use at: Baseline and endline.*
